sources.claim: Bianca Harris is a full-spectrum doula based in Victoria, Texas, working toward CLC and PMH-C certifications
sources.quote: I am a Certified Therapeutic Recreation Specialist (CTRS), Full Spectrum Doula and am currently working toward my Certified Lactation Counselor (CLC) and Perinatal Mental Health Certification (PMH-C).

sources.claim: Victoria Doulas is a local collective of antepartum, labor, postpartum, and bereavement doulas serving Victoria, Texas
sources.quote: Victoria Doulas is comprised of Antepartum, Labor, Postpartum and Bereavement doulas, as well as birth photographers, placenta specialists, a trained chef specializing in postpartum needs, and CPST and lactation consultant referrals.

sources.claim: Baby Brilliance serves Victoria, Cuero, and Corpus Christi with newborn care and postpartum support
sources.quote: Baby Brilliance proudly serves families throughout South Texas including Cuero, Victoria, Corpus Christi, Rockport, Port Lavaca, Goliad, Gonzales, Yoakum, Edna, Beeville, and all surrounding communities.

sources.claim: Citizens Birth Center is the only hospital in Victoria with labor and delivery through Level II NICU care under one roof
sources.quote: Citizens Birth Center is the only hospital in Victoria that has care from labor and delivery to intensive care for both mommy and baby under one roof.

sources.claim: DeTar Healthcare System has delivered more than 70,000 babies since 1925 and provides maternity care at DeTar Hospital North
sources.quote: Since our start in 1925, DeTar Healthcare System has delivered more than 70,000 babies.

sources.claim: DeTar Hospital Navarro is located at 506 E San Antonio Street, Victoria, TX 77901
sources.quote: Detar Hospital Navarro. 506 E San Antonio St, Victoria TX 77901.
